propositions: two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors in monitoring_s4b.tf and replication_errors in monitoring_s5.tf) declare neither alarm_actions nor ok_actions, causing alarm transitions to fire silently with no notifications
the voter_errors alarm is critical to the fail-closed path for LLM-Review vote gating on main branch merges, and its silence prevents operator discovery of unsubmittable changes
eleven of thirteen aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks in infra/terraform/ wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn, establishing a clear repo convention that these two omit

a new test guard was added (test_alarm_actions_terraform.py) to parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block and enforce the presence of alarm_actions, with anti-vacuity assertions and explicit opt-out markers to prevent future silent alarms
terraform apply is required to wire the SNS actions in production; the merged HCL change does not mutate live AWS alarms without an operator-executed terraform apply
